operation_details.item: The user's Q4 budget model covers the marketing department.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: How’s the Q4 planning work coming along?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: It’s going well. I’m building the Q4 budget model for the marketing department.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Nice. Are you setting it up from scratch or updating an existing template?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I built it in Excel, with separate headcount and opex lines.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That should make the assumptions easier to review. Have you started checking the main drivers yet?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yes, I’m working through the drivers now and trying to keep the structure flexible rather than overly detailed.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Sounds practical. When do you need to walk someone through it?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: The review with the FP&A director is next week, so I’m polishing the model before then.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Please forget only that the Q4 budget model covers the marketing department, while keeping the model structure, tool, and review date.
